about: UI Lua files that need no UI emulation profile beyond the selected ones (reviewed, or verified against the real game), by name and sha256, and the official DLC folders whose UI is the base game's. The run report (host-report.json uiFiles) lists every other non-base UI file as unknown. Add files with python -m civ5headless.hazards known; docs/profiles.md says how to review a file.
